extracted.intended_audience: Members of the IWG, EDAC structure, and staff of participating intelligence agencies (IWG Secretariat, producing agencies, subgroup chairs)
extracted.subtask_description: Internal administrative procedures governing IWG meetings, agenda-setting, assignment and preparation of intelligence studies, working-paper handling, approval and release channels, acting-chair designations, and use of standard case forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing and place of meetings
rubrics_metrics.description: The Executive Secretary, with the advice and consent of the Chairmen, shall arrange for meetings of IWG and shall notify members in advance of the time, place and agenda for such meetings, which normally will be held each week on Thursday morning at 10:00 a.m.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Meetings are normally weekly Thursday 10:00 a.m.; Executive Secretary arranges meetings with Chairmen's agreement and must notify members in advance of time, place, and agenda.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agenda notice and paper distribution requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: No substantive matter should be placed on the agenda for action unless the member agencies have had notice at least two working days in advance of the meeting at which the subject is to be discussed; agencies should notify the IWG Secretariat three full working days in advance of matters to be placed on the agenda. When the agenda item involves presentation of a paper, distribution of this paper should be aside so as to allow at least one week for review prior to IWG consideration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies are incumbent to notify Secretariat three full working days in advance (when possible). Chairman may suspend these requirements at his discretion. It is suggested submitting papers in hecto or other reproducible form to the Secretariat for reproduction and distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assignment of responsibility for IWG production
rubrics_metrics.description: When IWG determines an intelligence study should be produced in response to a request, the Chairman shall assign responsibility, with the consent of the agency concerned, for its preparation to (1) a subgroup of IWG or (2) a member agency of IWG; alternatively the Chairman may refer the problem to the Executive Committee of EDAC, the EIC, or another interdepartmental group if beyond IWG competence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When subgroups are constituted, non-members may be invited to participate. IWG members shall be appointed (whenever practicable) to chair such subgroups. If a non-member is appointed chair, it is the responsibility of a member representing the chair's agency to keep the IWG advised of subgroup activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of 'An IWG report'
rubrics_metrics.description: "An IWG report" denotes any intelligence document which the IWG has approved as such with the consent of the originating agency or agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This defines which documents count as official IWG reports (approval by IWG plus consent of source agencies).

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission and pre-approval of studies (working papers)
rubrics_metrics.description: Studies prepared for IWG shall be submitted through the Executive Secretary, IWG, as working papers for review prior to their approval as IWG reports. Approval for release of papers so submitted shall have been obtained from source agencies by the producing agency, working group, or individual analyst prior to transmittal; a statement that such approval has been obtained will be appended to each draft working paper submitted to the Executive Secretary, who will assign an appropriate number and effect its distribution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Producing agency must obtain release approval from source agencies before submitting drafts; Executive Secretary handles numbering and distribution. (See also referenced attachment paragraphs.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Working-paper draft status and internal dissemination limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Working papers submitted to IWG shall be considered to remain in draft until acted upon by IWG and shall not be disseminated outside the IWG, with the exception that IWG members may make limited dissemination within their own agencies on a 'need to know' basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Until IWG acts, papers are drafts and external dissemination is prohibited except limited internal agency sharing on need-to-know.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concurrence/dissent process and consensus development
rubrics_metrics.description: When working papers are submitted to IWG for review prior to release to the requestor or otherwise, a copy shall be furnished to members, who will be requested to indicate to the Executive Secretary within a Chairman-determined time limit their concurrence, dissent, reservation, or proposal to furnish additional intelligence. The preparing agency will then make every effort to produce a report representing the intelligence consensus of those member agencies with an interest or whose intelligence was used. The Chairman may appoint a subgroup to review and prepare a revised paper. Following IWG approval, the report will be forwarded with any remaining dissents, comments, or additional intelligence to the requestor and given authorized IWG dissemination. If time or the nature of dissents prevents a concurred report, the report may be forwarded with dissents or additional intelligence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishes process and timelines for members to register positions; encourages consensus but allows forwarding with documented dissents when consensus cannot be achieved in time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegation of acting chairman
rubrics_metrics.description: The Chairman, in the event of his absence from duty, shall designate an Acting Chairman for the period of absence. Such Acting Chairman shall have the powers of the Chairman.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Chairman is responsible for designating an acting official who assumes full chairman powers during absence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approval channel for incorporated agency material
rubrics_metrics.description: When material from intelligence agencies is incorporated in an IWG paper, IWG members shall serve (whenever practicable) as the channel through which approval for release of such material may be obtained from the producing agency, subgroup, or individual analyst.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Members should act as intermediaries to secure release approvals for source material used in IWG papers, to ensure proper clearance before inclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of IWG case forms and establishment of IWG cases
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for intelligence production, reports of apparent violations of Free World economic defense controls, and collection requirements relative to such apparent violations shall be submitted on the standard IWG case forms and made the subject of IWG cases, in the discretion of the Chairman. When an IWG case is established, each member shall secure from his agency and submit to the Executive Secretary (or as directed) for retention or for information and return all available pertinent information or intelligence, or recommendations as required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standardized case forms must be used for production requests and violation reports; the Chairman decides whether to open a case; members must collect and submit pertinent agency information to the Secretariat for case records.
